date.as_written: samvat 962 āṣāḍhamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe aṣṭamyāyān tithau revatimakṣatre surayoge śaniścaravārasare

purpose: for the merit of their deceased mother (svamātāyā nāmna)
notes: A second date (NS 962 Jyeṣṭha śudi 6 somavāra) records a death in the family ('samāptā cittani divaṃgata juyā o'). A second son ('dvitīyaputraśrī…') is also mentioned as co-sponsor, but his personal name is lost in a lacuna.
